key_findings: The 10 high-priority images from one session exhibit repeated left-biased smoke boxes despite right-side smoke or no clear smoke.

A different session contains a T box clearly displaced from both major bright regions (obs_000556), a possible empty-label hotspot omission (obs_000653), and a plausible two-target frame (obs_000843).
Thermal brightness alone does not establish fire relevance; pre-ignition obs_000787 is a hard-negative candidate.
Time proximity alone does not prove T/V detections are the same physical fire event.
next_action: Finish independent raw-image review of remaining 56 observations, adjudicate exact labels in a separate validation dataset with weak/ambiguous/unusable policy, then perform exploratory frozen-model validation. Do not use these frames for training or claim them as untouched blind test.
